integrity: Analytic proof includes the exact stationary transform, uniform tilted Fourier local limit and tail integration. A separate executable checker performs finite consistency tests; those tests do not establish the asymptotic limit.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is uniform for scaled displacements in compact subsets of (0,infinity), not for displacement tending to zero or infinity jointly with weak contraction. It assumes symmetric Brownian diffusion and Poisson partial resetting; independent scientific novelty and validity audit have not been performed.
title: Sharp dilogarithmic stationary-tail prefactor under weak partial resetting
